requirements.criterion: Existing accessible workspace accepted; missing or inaccessible directory refused before process launch.
Real controlled task execution reaches coherent observed success, failure or timeout states.
Cancellation remains pending until child termination is observed.
Duplicate actions, workspace changes while busy and late events cannot corrupt another attempt.
Execution and verification leave the actual interface responsive.
Independent oracle approves the correct task-produced result and rejects incorrect bytes or identity.
Absent evidence and completion claims never approve a result.
Changed inputs invalidate current acceptance while preserving prior observations.
Exclusive task directories preserve all preexisting workspace content.
Window close supervises owned work through termination before application exit.
Five evidence states, criterion, attempt, verification run, inputs and observation freshness are visible.

limitations: Existing desktop harness does not yet cover this feature; traceability must be refined with implementation.
